blocks.prompt: 5. A team of environmental scientists is monitoring the oxygen level in a lake over time to ensure the water quality remains suitable for aquatic life. The oxygen level in the lake, measured in milligrams per liter (mg/L), is modeled by the equation \(O(t) = t^{3} - 18t^{2} + 81t + 100\), where \(O(t)\) is the oxygen level at time \(t\) (in days after monitoring began). Scientists want to determine when during the monitoring period the oxygen level is at its lowest, as low oxygen levels can be harmful to fish and other aquatic organisms. Find the time \(t\) when the oxygen level is at its minimum.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh minimum ka sawal hai, aur yahan function pehle se aik variable \(t\) mein diya hua hai, is liye function banane ki zaroorat nahi.
Diya kya hai? Jheel mein oxygen ka level \(O(t) = t^{3} - 18t^{2} + 81t + 100\) mg/L, jahan \(t\) din hain.
Find kya karna hai? Woh waqt \(t\) jab oxygen sab se kam ho (machhliyon ke liye sab se khatarnak waqt).
Rule kaunsa? \(O'(t) = 0\) se critical points, phir \(O''(t)\) se faisla ke kaun sa maximum hai aur kaun sa minimum.
Plan: aakhir mein values nikal kar compare bhi karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(O(t) = t^{3} - 18t^{2} + 81t + 100\) mg/L ...(1), \(t\) din mein, \(t \ge 0\).
Maloom karna: oxygen ka level kab sab se kam hai.
Tareeqa: critical points, phir second derivative test.

Critical points
\[\dfrac{dO}{dt} = 3t^{2} - 36t + 81 \quad \text{...(2)}\]
\[t^{2} - 12t + 27 = 0\]
\[(t - 3)(t - 9) = 0\]
\[t = 3 \ \text{ ya } \ t = 9\]
Kyun: har term par power rule; constant 100 ka derivative zero. Phir 3 se divide kiya, aur aise do numbers dhoonde jin ka product 27 aur jama \(-12\) ho: \(-3\) aur \(-9\).

Second derivative test
\[\dfrac{d^{2}O}{dt^{2}} = 6t - 36\]
\[t = 3: \ 18 - 36 = -18 < 0\]
\[t = 9: \ 54 - 36 = 18 > 0\]
Kyun: \(t = 3\) par negative, yani local maximum (oxygen sab se zyada); \(t = 9\) par positive, yani local minimum.
Dhyan dein: dono critical points ko "jawab" mat likh dijiye; sawal sirf minimum maangta hai.

Oxygen levels
\[O(3) = 27 - 162 + 243 + 100 = 208\]
\[O(9) = 729 - 1458 + 729 + 100 = 100\]
Kyun: values se kahani saaf hoti hai: teesre din level 208 mg/L tak barhta hai, aur nauwen din gir kar 100 mg/L reh jata hai.

Tasdeeq aur matlab
\[O(0) = 100, \quad O(8) = 108, \quad O(10) = 110\]
Shuru mein bhi level 100 mg/L tha. Nauwen din yeh wapas usi value par aata hai aur phir dobara barhne lagta hai (\(t > 9\) ke liye \(O'(t) > 0\)). Is liye monitoring shuru hone ke baad sab se kam level ka waqt nauwan din hai. Parosi din 8 aur 10 par level zyada hai, jo minimum ki tasdeeq karta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Oxygen ka level \(t = 9\) din par sab se kam hai, jab \(O(9) = 100\) mg/L.
